name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio:
Dimitrios discovered his passion for motorsport while helping his uncle repair vintage scooters in their small village workshop. This early exposure sparked an interest in mechanics, eventually leading him to pursue fabrication. He's fresh out of a vocational program with a strong foundation in welding and metalworking, and he's eager to apply his skills in a fast-paced racing environment.

Dimitrios takes a systematic approach to his work, prioritizing precision and durability. While he's still developing his speed and efficiency, his dedication to quality and his ability to troubleshoot effectively make him a valuable asset. He's particularly interested in learning more about advanced materials and fabrication techniques used in modern race cars. His long-term goal is to become a lead fabricator, responsible for building and maintaining critical components.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Dimitrios is of average height, with a sturdy build from years of physical work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his tools after each use.
Prefers to listen to traditional Greek music while working, though he keeps the volume low.
